# P37.41 — Source changelog

Row 465 of 510 · `R11-K13-UX10-4` (K10 UX10-4 §15; K13 §7 W3; J5) · base
`r11/P37.40-changes-page-feeds` · gate `none` (plan cell, verbatim) · not an

**Requirement ids stamped (spec §56 `Owner:` names this row): SIG-TRANSP-042.**

## What lands

The per-source changelog — an append-only event log generated from records
with trustworthy clocks, **never** from version-control dates (§56.10,
SIG-TRANSP-042: "Each source MUST have a changelog generated from
append-only records and release diffs, dated by those records' clocks,
never by version-control dates."):

- `web/src/lib/source-changelog.ts` (new) — the `sig.source-changelog/1`
  document (`{event_id, source_id, kind, at, clock_basis, summary_code,
  refs[]}` + additive `detail`) and the generator `buildSourceChangelog`
  over the named seams: the `sig.source-row/1` rights record
  (`decided_at`), `sig.execution-record/1` runs (`finished_at` — first
  ingest + connector-version transitions), `sig.source-versions/1`
  (release activation — first publication + the baseline label), the
  TX-14 diff set read through P37.40's `getReleaseChanges` (activation —
  `added`/`retired`/`newly_failing`/`lane_changed` lifecycle rows and the
  per-source `source_ids` slice of `sig.release-changes-feed/1` →
  added/removed/changed record events), `sig.source-issue/1`
  (`opened_at`/`closed_at`), `source:<id>`-keyed corrections
  (`corrected_at`), `sig.attribution-corrections/1` (`decided_at`) and
  the publication-withdrawals table (`recorded_at`). Closed `CLOCK_BASES`
  vocabulary; summaries render from codes, never free text; the K10 §15
  baseline wording ("History before `<label>`: rights decisions and run
  records only.").
- `/sources/<id>/changelog/` (new, T1, zero-JS) — the full event table,
  newest first, 100 per page (`…/page/<n>/`), the baseline note, the
  disclosures, the typed EmptyState; `index.json` twin serves the doc
  verbatim. Registry-only (S-11) sources emit no changelog route.
- `/sources/<id>/` — the "Changelog" section (last ten events + the
  baseline sentence + the event-count figure), the page-B list row and
  the subnav item; `index.json` gains `changelog` (`event_count`,
  `baseline_label`, `latest[]`) + `links.changelog`.
- `SourceSubnav` — the `changelog` item; every page-B sibling `has` set
  gains the flag (the route emits for every non-registry source).
- `figures.ts` + `check-figures.mjs` — `TRANSPARENCY_SOURCE_RE` admits
  `changelog.json` (the K10 §16.1 artifact name); `SOURCE_ROW_SEGMENTS`
  skips `changelog/` as the same row-list surface class (the per-row
  counts stay row data; the page's own `figures[]` still registers).
- `source-page.ts` fixture — `demo-exec-okc-3` carries `0.1.0-demo` so the
  connector-version event exercises end to end.
- `batch-27.md` — SCL-01…24 + PB-09 drafted sentences (`pending` until the
  operator confirms verbatim, B-2); `tests/unit/test_p37_41_copy_batch.py`
  hash-verifies + binds them.
- Tests: `web/tests/unit/source-changelog.test.ts` (10) — every kind +
  clock, the AT-K10-08 shape (lane change→activation, rights
  decision→decided_at, issue close→closed_at), sort/id uniqueness, the
  typed absences; `web/tests/e2e/source-changelog.spec.ts` (7) — page +
  twin + section + S-11 + zero-JS.
- `COVERAGE_MATRIX.csv` — SIG-TRANSP-042 → `MET-ENGINEERED(D-R10-PUBLISH-1)`
  (the public-domain leg rides the open publish deferral, SIG-ENG-041).
- `CHANGELOG.md` — the P37.41 entry.
